sect1.title: x265-&x265-version;

sect2.title: Introduction to x265
sect2.para: x265 package provides a library for encoding video streams into the H.265/HEVC format.

sect2.title: Installation of x265
sect2.para: Fix building for 32-bit as an incomplete check routes 32-bit through PLT, which 32-bit can't do:
Install x265 by running the following commands:

screen.userinput:
mkdir bld && cd bld &&
cmake -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr \ -D GIT_ARCHETYPE=1 \ -W no-author ../source && make

sect2.para: To install the package, first remove any old library versions. After installation, remove a static library. As the &root; user:

sect2.title: lib32-Installation of x265
sect2.para: Install lib32-x265 by running the following commands:

screen.userinput:
rm -rf * && CC="gcc -m32" CXX="g++ -m32" \ PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/usr/lib32/pkgconfig \ cmake -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr \ -D LIB_INSTALL_DIR=lib32 \ -D GIT_ARCHETYPE=1 \ -W no-author ../source &&
make

sect2.para: To install the package, first remove any old library versions. After installation, remove a static library. As the &root; user:

screen.userinput: make DESTDIR=$PWD/DESTDIR install && cp -vR DESTDIR/usr/lib32/* /usr/lib32 && rm -vf /usr/lib32/libx265.a && rm -rf DESTDIR && ldconfig

sect1.sect2:
Command Explanations
&options-cmake;
-D GIT_ARCHETYPE=1: This switch is needed because the build system will not generate a pkg-config file or install a shared library unless Git is installed. Git isn't required for anything else in this package, so this switch is used to work around it for users who do not want to install Git as a build dependency.
-W no-author: This switch is used to suppress warnings intended for the package developers.
rm -vf /usr/lib{,32}/libx265.a: This removes an unnecessary static library.

listitem.para: provides the functions used to encode video streams into the H.265/HEVC format
